name: Bean-Shaped Pillow with Scrolling Peony Decor on the Headrest and with Scrolling Foliage Decor around the Sides
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；late 11th cent. - early 12th cent.；Cizhou ware: light gray stoneware with pale glaze over decoration incised, carved, and combed into the white slip ground.  Probably from the Tangyangyu kilns, Xiuwu county, Henan province.
